title: Brazil’s Presidential Election Heads to a High-Stakes Runoff
subtitle: Far-right candidate Flávio Bolsonaro leads the first round, leaving incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva facing a difficult path to victory.

summary.en: Brazil's presidential election will move to a second round on October 25 after no candidate won a majority. Far-right candidate Flávio Bolsonaro finished the first round with 47% of the vote, slightly ahead of current President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. This result marks a significant shift in Brazilian politics as the right-wing movement gains strength across the country. Supporters of Lula now face a difficult challenge to close the gap before the final vote. Political experts suggest that the outcome of this election could have long-lasting effects on the nation's future.
summary.zh: 巴西總統大選因無候選人獲得過半票數，將於十月二十五日進入第二輪投票。極右翼候選人弗拉維奧·波索納洛以百分之四十七的得票率在首輪領先，微幅領先現任總統魯拉。此結果標誌著巴西政治的重大轉變，右翼勢力在全國範圍內日益壯大。魯拉的支持者現在面臨在最終投票前縮小差距的艱鉅挑戰。政治專家認為，此次選舉結果可能對國家未來產生深遠影響。

paragraphs.en: Brazil is preparing for a tense final stage in its presidential election after the first round of voting ended without a clear winner. According to The Guardian, 45-year-old right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro finished the first round in the lead with 47.03% of the vote. The current president, 80-year-old Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, followed closely with 45.16%. Because neither candidate received more than half of the total votes, the election will move to a second round, known as a runoff, on October 25.
paragraphs.zh: 巴西正準備迎接總統大選緊張的最後階段，因為首輪投票結束後並未出現明顯的勝出者。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，四十五歲的右翼候選人弗拉維奧·波索納洛（Flávio Bolsonaro）以百分之四十七點零三的得票率在首輪領先。現任總統、八十歲的魯拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）則以百分之四十五點一六緊追在後。由於兩位候選人都未獲得過半票數，選舉將進入十月二十五日的第二輪決選。

paragraphs.en: This result has surprised many observers, as the race between the two candidates remains very tight. NPR reports that Lula now faces a difficult challenge to win the final ballot. To succeed, he must attract new voters, particularly the millions of citizens who chose not to vote in the first round. Additionally, he needs to win over the 8% of voters who supported other candidates, most of whom lean toward right-wing or far-right politics. Many Brazilians who are unhappy with the current political climate had hoped for younger, alternative candidates, which has made the current situation feel uncertain for many supporters.
paragraphs.zh: 此結果令許多觀察家感到意外，因為兩位候選人之間的競爭依然非常激烈。美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）報導指出，魯拉現在面臨贏得最終投票的艱鉅挑戰。為了成功，他必須爭取新的選民，特別是數百萬在首輪選擇不投票的公民。此外，他還需要贏得那百分之八支持其他候選人的選民，這些選民大多傾向右翼或極右翼政治。許多對當前政治氛圍不滿的巴西人曾期待出現更年輕、非傳統的候選人，這使得許多支持者對當前局勢感到不安。

paragraphs.en: The election results represent a major success for the Bolsonaro family and their political allies. The Guardian noted that the Liberal Party (PL), which supports Flávio Bolsonaro, has secured the largest number of seats in the Brazilian senate. This shift in power is significant because it gives the right-wing movement a majority in the upper house of congress. Furthermore, several key allies of the former president, Jair Bolsonaro, were elected to important positions, including the governorships of major states like São Paulo and Paraná. Political scientist Miguel Lago described the current situation as a revolution, noting that the far-right movement is growing consistently in every election.
paragraphs.zh: 選舉結果對波索納洛家族及其政治盟友而言是一次重大勝利。《衛報》指出，支持弗拉維奧·波索納洛的自由黨（Liberal Party, PL）已在巴西參議院取得最多席次。這種權力轉移意義重大，因為它讓右翼勢力在國會上議院掌握了多數。此外，前總統雅伊爾·波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）的幾位重要盟友也當選了關鍵職位，包括聖保羅州（São Paulo）和巴拉那州（Paraná）等大州的州長。政治學家米格爾·拉戈（Miguel Lago）將當前局勢形容為一場革命，並指出極右翼運動在每次選舉中都在持續成長。

paragraphs.en: For the incumbent, Lula, the path forward is steep. Since Brazil returned to democracy in 1985, no candidate who finished second in the first round has ever come back to win the presidency in the runoff. While Lula previously led the country from 2002 to 2010—a time when a global boom in commodities helped fund social programs that lifted millions out of poverty—his current campaign is struggling to stop the momentum of the far-right movement. Experts suggest that the current election is the most difficult for progressive and moderate parties in decades.
paragraphs.zh: 對於現任總統魯拉而言，前方的道路相當艱難。自從巴西在一九八五年恢復民主以來，從未有在首輪投票中排名第二的候選人能在決選中逆轉勝出。雖然魯拉曾於二○○二年至二○一○年間領導國家，當時全球大宗商品繁榮有助於資助社會計畫，使數百萬人脫離貧困，但他目前的競選活動正難以阻擋極右翼運動的氣勢。專家認為，這次選舉是進步派與溫和派政黨數十年來面臨最困難的一次。

paragraphs.en: International attention is also focused on the race. Donald Trump, a long-time ally of the Bolsonaro family, recently spoke to reporters outside the White House, calling the first-round result a “big victory” for Flávio Bolsonaro. He predicted that the upcoming runoff would be a very close contest. Meanwhile, the political implications of the result are already being felt in Brasília. If the pro-Bolsonaro coalition maintains its current strength in the senate, they may be able to approve an amnesty—a legal decision to forgive or overlook past actions—for the former president, Jair Bolsonaro. This could allow him to return to a more active role in politics after his current period of house arrest.
paragraphs.zh: 國際社會也密切關注這場選戰。長期作為波索納洛家族盟友的川普（Donald Trump）最近在白宮外對記者表示，首輪結果對弗拉維奧·波索納洛來說是一場「大勝利」。他預測即將到來的決選將會是一場非常接近的競爭。與此同時，該結果的政治影響已在巴西利亞（Brasília）發酵。如果親波索納洛聯盟能在參議院維持目前的實力，他們或許能批准一項特赦，即一項針對過去行為予以寬恕或不予追究的法律決定，這可能讓前總統雅伊爾·波索納洛在目前的居家監禁期滿後，重返更活躍的政治角色。

paragraphs.en: As the country moves toward the final vote on October 25, the mood among voters remains divided. Many supporters of Lula are worried about the strong performance of the far-right, while supporters of the Bolsonaro movement see this as a chance to reshape the nation's future. The coming weeks will be critical as both campaigns work to convince undecided voters. With the senate now under the control of the Liberal Party and its allies, the stakes for this election have never been higher. The result of this runoff will determine not only the next president but also the direction of Brazil’s government for years to come.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著國家邁向十月二十五日的最終投票，選民之間的情緒依然分歧。許多魯拉的支持者對極右翼的強勢表現感到擔憂，而波索納洛運動的支持者則將此視為重塑國家未來的機會。未來幾週將至關重要，因為兩個陣營都在努力爭取尚未決定投票意向的選民。隨著參議院現在由自由黨及其盟友掌控，這場選舉的賭注從未如此之高。決選結果不僅將決定下一任總統，也將決定巴西政府未來多年的發展方向。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To persuade someone to support you or agree with you, especially when they were previously against you or undecided.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 爭取（某人的）支持；說服（某人）站在自己這邊。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此片語由動詞 win 與介系詞 over 組成，意思與「贏得」有所不同，強調說服的過程。文中：Additionally, he needs to win over the 8% of voters who supported other candidates, most of whom lean toward right-wing or far-right politics.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Difficult to achieve or overcome; demanding.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作形容詞描述坡度「陡峭」，這裡用來比喻挑戰非常困難。文中：For the incumbent, Lula, the path forward is steep.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The risks involved in a situation; what can be gained or lost.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（打賭），這裡作名詞表示事情的重要性與風險程度。文中：With the senate now under the control of the Liberal Party and its allies, the stakes for this election have never been higher.

quiz.question: What specific advantage does the Liberal Party (PL) hold following the first round of the election?

options.A: They have secured the presidency for Flávio Bolsonaro.
options.B: They have gained a majority of seats in the Brazilian senate.
options.C: They have successfully removed the incumbent from the ballot.
options.D: They have gained control over all major state governorships.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，文中明確提到自由黨（PL）在巴西參議院獲得了最多的席次，這使右翼運動在上議院取得了多數優勢。選項 A 錯誤，因為第一輪投票並未產生獲勝者，還需要進行第二輪決選。選項 C 錯誤，因為現任總統 Lula 仍在競選中。選項 D 錯誤，文中僅提到他們贏得了一些關鍵州的州長職位，而非「所有」主要州。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why might the upcoming runoff be particularly challenging for Lula?

options.A: He has never participated in a runoff election before.
options.B: He is required to win over voters who generally oppose his political ideology.
options.C: He has lost the support of the global commodities market.
options.D: He is currently under house arrest, preventing him from campaigning.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第二段，Lula 需要爭取那些支持其他候選人的 8% 選民，而這些選民大多傾向於右翼或極右翼政治，這與 Lula 的背景相左。選項 A 錯誤，文中並未提到他的過去選舉經驗。選項 C 錯誤，文中提到的是過去的商品熱潮幫助了他，而非他現在失去了市場支持。選項 D 錯誤，文中提到被軟禁的是前總統 Jair Bolsonaro，而非 Lula。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the author mean by describing the path forward for Lula as 'steep'?

options.A: The path is physically dangerous to travel on.
options.B: The path is geographically located in a mountainous region.
options.C: The path to victory is extremely difficult to achieve.
options.D: The path is becoming shorter as the election date approaches.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。在此處，「steep」並非指物理上的坡度，而是隱喻競選之路充滿阻礙、難以達成目標。選項 A 錯誤，這不是指實體的危險。選項 B 錯誤，這是對形容詞的字面誤解。選項 D 錯誤，文中並未提到時間長短與路徑的關聯，且 steep 在此處與難度有關，而非距離。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the article regarding the Brazilian election?

options.A: To provide a biography of the Bolsonaro family's political history.
options.B: To explain why Donald Trump is interested in Brazilian politics.
options.C: To detail the historical economic success of Brazil under Lula.
options.D: To analyze the uncertain and high-stakes nature of the upcoming runoff election.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。整篇文章的核心在於描述第一輪投票後的局勢、雙方候選人面臨的挑戰、參議院權力結構的改變，以及這場決選對巴西未來方向的高度重要性。選項 A 只是文章的一部分內容。選項 B 僅在第五段短暫提及。選項 C 僅是背景資訊，並非文章主旨。因此 D 最能涵蓋全文意旨。
